title: FLACidal extension manifest (extension.json)
description: Full manifest bundled inside an extension's downloadable zip as extension.json. Mirrors FLACidal-Core's ExtensionManifest struct (plus the SourceExtCfg, MetadataExtCfg, and AuthField types it embeds). This is a superset of the minimal shape used by index.json entries -- see registry-entry.schema.json for that.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier for the extension. Used as its install directory name and as the key in Core's extension map.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the app.

version.description: The extension's own semver, for the contents of this zip. Distinct from index.json's latestVersion, which is a listing-only field maintained separately -- see README.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum FLACidal app version this extension requires. Not marked required by this schema (an empty/omitted value is treated as "no minimum"), even though the Go struct has no `omitempty` on this field -- that only affects marshal-out behavior, not what Core accepts on install.

description.description: Short summary of what the extension does.
examples: Streams and downloads Acme's hi-res FLAC catalog, and enriches tracks with Acme's editorial metadata.

category.description: Free-form category used for grouping in the app's Browse tab. Suggested values (not enforced by Core): "download", "metadata", "lyrics", "utility".

capabilities.description: What this extension can do. Suggested values (not enforced by Core): "source", "metadata", "resolver". Determines which of sourceConfig/metadataConfig the app expects to find populated.

permissions.description: Permissions the extension requests, shown to the user before install. Suggested value (not enforced by Core): "network".

canDownload.description: Whether this extension can act as a download source. Pairs with sourceConfig and downloadPriority.

downloadPriority.description: Order in which download-capable extensions are tried. Lower is tried first; 0 disables the extension as a download source.

sourceConfig.description: Source (download) configuration. Present when capabilities includes "source".

canEnrichMetadata.description: Whether this extension can act as a metadata enrichment source. Pairs with metadataConfig and metadataPriority.

metadataPriority.description: Order in which metadata-capable extensions are tried. Lower is tried first; 0 disables the extension as a metadata source.

metadataConfig.description: Metadata enrichment configuration. Present when capabilities includes "metadata".

authFields.description: Credential fields the app should prompt the user for and pass through as request headers (auth data is keyed by these fields' `key`).

name.description: Internal identifier for this source. Distinct from the manifest's top-level name -- this is the source's own key (e.g. used in logs).

displayName.description: Human-readable source name shown in the app.

urlPattern.description: Regex matched against a shared/pasted URL's host to route it to this extension.

baseUrl.description: Base URL the endpoint fields below are relative to.

trackEndpoint.description: Endpoint for fetching a single track.

streamEndpoint.description: Endpoint for resolving a track's streamable/downloadable URL.

trackMapping.description: Maps FLACidal track fields to dot-separated JSON paths in this source API's response.

albumMapping.description: Maps FLACidal album fields to dot-separated JSON paths in this source API's response.

streamUrlField.description: Dot-separated JSON path to the streamable URL within the streamEndpoint response.

baseUrl.description: Base URL the lookupEndpoint field is relative to.

lookupEndpoint.description: Endpoint for looking up metadata by ISRC, templated with {isrc}.

fieldMapping.description: Maps a TrackMetadata field name to a dot-separated JSON path in the lookup response.

authField.description: Mirrors FLACidal-Core's AuthField struct. One entry per credential the app should collect from the user.

key.description: Key this credential is stored/passed under (e.g. as a request header name).

label.description: Label shown to the user in the credential entry form.

type.description: Input type hint for the credential entry form. Suggested values (not enforced by Core): "text", "password".

required.description: Whether the user must fill in this field before the extension can be used.
